description: This file defines the CrashReporter class responsible for handling application crash reports, logging them via an analytics manager, and displaying a dialog to the user for feedback.

classes.name: CrashReporter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for crash reporting logic, including logging and user notification.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Logs the crash event and shows a dialog to inform the user.

methods.name: getStackTrace
methods.description: Converts a Throwable's stack trace to a String.

methods.name: showCrashDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog prompting the user to send crash report data.

methods.name: sendCrashReport
methods.description: Sends crash stack trace to a crash reporting service (simulated by logging here).

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides thread-safe singleton access to CrashReporter instance.
